item: In-app update: Settings > Advanced > Updates checks GitHub for a newer release tag and installs it (stop, git fast-forward, restart)
status: built; unit-tested with real git; click-through and a live update unverified
summary: Check for update asks api.github.com (guarded session, kill switch, one consent popup) for the highest vX.Y.Z tag; Update and restart is a separate confirm, then the app stops cleanly and scripts/apply_update.py fast-forwards main to the checked sha (origin pinned, clean tree, fetched commit must equal the checked one, a version that changes dependencies is refused untouched and left to the installer, so no package is ever downloaded; a new version that does not start is undone) and relaunches; the apply is refused while airplane mode is on or protected mode is chosen and goes through the consent popup, the helper and its children run without the passphrase variables, files are never swapped under a running app, and a helper that fails still restarts the app; the Windows launcher waits for a key in a frozen file; installs that are not such a git checkout are shown manual steps; new App updates network lane, x12 locales; tags are not signature-verified.
